newsitem.title: HONG KONG: APP Global Finance US$500 mln FRN oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: APP Global Finance US$500 mln FRN oversubscribed.

text.p: APP Global Finance's five-year US$500 million floating rate note issue has been oversubscribed by 20-25 percent in syndication, arranger Union Bank of Switzerland said.
The borrower has not yet decided whether it will increase the FRN or scale back allotments, UBS said. Allocations are expected to be made on Monday.
Most of the paper was taken by Asian accounts.
The issue size, at US$500 million, is very large for an Asian-targeted deal. Most transactions of that size for Asian borrowers are sold into the U.S. Yankee market.
Proceeds of the FRN ultimately will be used by Asia Pulp and Paper.
